items.rationale: Frost fracture of a fitting inside the building is covered under 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9. Priced at the level revealed in near-identical case 25.
A connection element renewed together with the fractured fitting is covered under 7.1.9. Priced at the revealed level.
Labour on covered fitting work is covered under 7.1.7(f). Prior cases showed 3 hrs fair at 279 or more.
Consumables used in covered work are in principle covered under 7.1.7(e). However, earlier cases on this wording came out at or near 0.
One attendance per undertaking is covered under 7.1.11. Priced at the case 25 level.
Leak location equipment is covered under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2, within the EUR 2,500 cap. Earlier revealed thresholds were below 28, possibly 0.
A return visit by the same undertaking is not separately indemnified without the insurer's prior agreement (7.1.11).

items.description: Remove loose and spalled plaster 2 pcs
items.rationale: The facade frost endorsement is agreed, so removal of failed material on the damaged elevation is covered under 2.6.2. Market estimate.
Re-forming the substrate on the damaged elevation is covered under 2.6.2.
Plastering of the damaged area is covered under 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c).
Priming is explicitly within the indemnity under 2.6.2.
Drying where needed before the new work can proceed is covered under 2.6.2.
The finish system in the coats the system requires is covered under 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d), on the damaged elevation only.
Labour of the tradespeople on covered facade work is covered under 2.6.2. Estimated at about 60 per hour.
The scaffold served only the damaged elevation (about 8 m wide, two storeys) and was struck before the rear work, so it is fully covered under 7.1.8 and 2.6.2.
Work on an undamaged elevation is excluded under 2.6.3(a) and 7.1.5.
Disposal of removed material is covered under 2.6.2 and 5.2.1. A few rubble sacks, so a small amount.
A charge that prices no work is excluded under 3.6(b) and 7.1.12.
Catering for the undertaking's own personnel is excluded under 3.6(a).
